# Create the PRD

Prerequisite: the user explicitly approved the BRD. Read the approved BRD and
the existing design doc as context; do not edit either.

Create or update only `docs/requirements/PRD.md`. Replace its scaffold with a
draft covering product summary, goals, users and journeys, MVP and deferred
scope, product behavior, measurable success measures, assumptions,
dependencies, open decisions, BRD traceability, and the approval record.

Preserve synthetic-only data use, indicators-for-human-review language, and
the four-day MVP constraint. Do not claim detection accuracy or compliance.
End with a review checklist and stop for human approval before FRD.
